title: BioIVT: months disease-free is calculated
description: Makes 'Number of months disease free' a read-only calculation: whole months from the remission date (or the therapy end date if there is no remission) to the recurrence date (or the date follow-up data was provided if there is no recurrence). Blank when a needed date is missing. The date questions are unchanged.
rationale: Dan asked for a proposal from the study design (status 'Disease free', remission, recurrence and therapy dates). A month is 30.4375 days.

set.field.calculation: if(if(${REMISSDT}!='', ${REMISSDT}, ${THER_ENDDT})='' or if(${REOCCURDT}!='', ${REOCCURDT}, ${DTFUPROV})='', '', if(decimal-date-time(if(${REOCCURDT}!='', ${REOCCURDT}, ${DTFUPROV})) < decimal-date-time(if(${REMISSDT}!='', ${REMISSDT}, ${THER_ENDDT})), '', int((decimal-date-time(if(${REOCCURDT}!='', ${REOCCURDT}, ${DTFUPROV})) - decimal-date-time(if(${REMISSDT}!='', ${REMISSDT}, ${THER_ENDDT}))) div 30.4375)))

source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
